    (IN GLOBAL-OBJECTS)

    (ADJECTIVE POND FISH)
    (DESC "fishing")
    (FLAGS NDESCBIT)>

<ROUTINE FAIR-PERSON-DESC-FCN ("OPTIONAL" (RARG <>))

           <TELL D ,DESC-OBJECT " is here." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE FAIR-PLACE-CAST ()
